SELECT cs.id, cs.student_id, s.nick_name AS student_name, s.head_image AS student_avatar, cs.job_id, j.job_name, cs.last_message_content, cs.last_message_time, cs.enterprise_unread_count AS unread_count, 0 AS is_online FROM chat_session cs LEFT JOIN student s ON cs.student_id = s.id LEFT JOIN job j ON cs.job_id = j.id WHERE cs.enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} AND cs.status = 1
AND (s.nick_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR s.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR j.job_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY cs.last_message_time DESC, cs.create_time DESC
